column2: Gallstones are hyperechoic and cast an acoustic shadow.

column2: A liver stiffness of 12 kPa suggests advanced fibrosis.
column3: Jigar qattiqligining 12 kPa bo‘lishi rivojlangan fibrozdan dalolat beradi.

column2: The resistive index of the renal artery is 0.7.
column3: Buyrak arteriyasining rezistivlik indeksi 0,7 ga teng.

column2: Color Doppler shows flow, while power Doppler is more sensitive to slow flow.
column3: Rangli Doppler oqimni ko‘rsatadi, energetik (power) Doppler esa sekin oqimga sezgirroq.

column2: Spectral Doppler gives the peak systolic velocity and the end diastolic velocity.
column3: Spektral Doppler sistolik cho‘qqi tezligi va diastola oxiridagi tezlikni beradi.
column4: spectral Doppler; peak systolic velocity; end diastolic velocity

column2: Aliasing appears when the pulse repetition frequency is too low.
column3: Impulslar takrorlanish chastotasi juda past bo‘lsa, aliasing paydo bo‘ladi.

column2: Hepatofugal flow in the portal vein is a sign of portal hypertension.
column3: Darvoza venasidagi gepatofugal oqim portal gipertenziya belgisidir.
column4: hepatofugal flow; portal vein; portal hypertension

column2: The lesion is well defined, but the mass next to it has irregular margins.
column3: O‘choq aniq chegarali, lekin uning yonidagi hosila notekis chegaraga ega.

column2: Not every tumor is malignant; a hemangioma is usually benign.
column3: Har bir o‘sma xavfli emas; gemangioma odatda xavfsiz bo‘ladi.

column2: Microcalcifications in a thyroid nodule raise the TI-RADS score.
column3: Qalqonsimon bez tugunidagi mikrokalsifikatlar TI-RADS tasnifi bo‘yicha xavf balini oshiradi.

column2: A taller than wide nodule is suspicious.
column3: Eniga nisbatan balandroq tugun shubhali hisoblanadi.

column2: Measure the crown rump length to date the pregnancy.
column3: Homiladorlik muddatini aniqlash uchun tepa-dumg‘aza uzunligini o‘lchang.

column2: The biparietal diameter and femur length are within normal limits.
column3: Biparietal diametr va son suyagi uzunligi me’yor chegarasida.

column2: Oligohydramnios means a low amniotic fluid index.
column3: Oligogidramnion amniotik suyuqlik indeksining pastligini bildiradi.

column2: Placenta previa covers the internal os of the cervix.
column3: Platsenta previada yo‘ldosh bachadon bo‘ynining ichki og‘zini yopadi.

column3: Endometriy qalinligi 8 mm.

column2: A dominant follicle is seen in the left ovary.
column3: Chap tuxumdonda dominant follikul ko‘rinadi.

column2: Free fluid in the pouch of Douglas may suggest an ectopic pregnancy.
column3: Douglas bo‘shlig‘idagi erkin suyuqlik bachadondan tashqari homiladorlikdan dalolat berishi mumkin.
